description: ASEP/Secretaria Nacional de Energía Datos Automóviles Eléctricos en Panamá is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos. Datos de automóviles eléctricos e híbridos proporcionados por la Secretaria Nacional de Energía (SNE) y la Asociación de Distribuidores de Automóviles de Panamá (ADAP). Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos . Its tags are Autos Eléctricos, Híbridos, Híbridos Enchufables. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2019-09-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
